candidate_scope.title: scSTAMP-seq (2025 preprint implementation)
candidate_scope.scope: Describe the general source-defined assay from the stated starting specimen through the molecular readout and its decoding. Preserve source-described alternative assay implementations and their prerequisites without merging them into one execution. Include necessary preparation, controls, information attribution and delegated procedural dependencies; distinguish method construction from characterization experiments and biological applications.

beyond_checklist_findings.candidate_claim: The operation presents the guide input-to-cycle rule but lists only 0.25–25, 25–150, 150–500 and 500–1000 ng. It does not state a <=1000-ng scope restriction or that this is a partial table.
beyond_checklist_findings.reason: The immediately adjacent registered guide rows extend the same sample-index-PCR decision table above 1000 ng. All quoted lower rows are genuine, but they do not support completeness of the represented control rule.
beyond_checklist_findings.consequence: Under the represented manufacturer branch a carry-forward input above 1000 ng has a source-defined recommendation missing from the extraction; no primary-run yield is claimed, so this is a conditional-rule omission rather than proof that the historical experiment used wrong cycles.
beyond_checklist_findings.required_correction: Include the two remaining reported rows with their guide qualification, or explicitly scope the extracted table as partial and do not advertise a complete cycle-selection rule. Preserve the overlapping boundary issue already noted.

beyond_checklist_findings.candidate_claim: Combines independent reporter measurements without treating the six PHOs as separate sequential optical bits.

short_witnesses.quote: If the spread arises from random processes rather than systematic biases

beyond_checklist_findings.reason: The primary motivates multiplexing with a conditional hypothesis about random versus systematic variability and reports improved assignment. Neither that observation nor the p00049 voting procedure establishes statistical independence of reporter errors. Multiple uniquely barcoded PHOs are distinct reporters, but distinctness alone is not independence.
beyond_checklist_findings.consequence: An unconditional independence statement adds an assumption that could overstate the rationale or transferability of the demonstrated noise reduction. The stated vote calculation itself remains reported.
beyond_checklist_findings.required_correction: Use distinct reporter measurements, or explicitly mark independence/random-error behavior as a hypothesis rather than an established property.

boundary_and_gap_assessments.assessment: Exact droplet amplification/SPRI ordering and stage-specific adapter mapping remain unresolved. The compound branch boundary and cautious descriptions are acceptable for the general source-defined architecture. A claim of a fully specified executable droplet route would require clarification. This audit does not silently resolve the apparent tension.

No exact scSTAMP oligo/primer inventory or RNA/gDNA cell-tag pairing map can be verified from the checked represented table labels. Exact sequence reconstruction/execution remains blocked; reported structural and role-level identities are still supported. The duplicate chemistry/information gap records describe different scope consequences; their blocking flags must not be treated as a count of independent unknown facts.

Further delegated IVT/post-IVT recipe and genomic site-offset internals, exact MAT capture-UMI length, zero-count/coordinate decoder implementation, and the Fig14-specific 15000 variable are genuinely unresolved at the claimed resolution. The source-supported transformations and final readouts are present. These are not grounds to invent recipes or declare general architecture absent.

Separate enriched transcript and unenriched methylated-site endpoint uses are supported. Inferring some retained allocation from mixed IVT product is explicitly labeled as an inference; timing/volume and a unique physical split mechanism are not established. Do not promote discarded enrichment capture supernatant to the epigenome branch.

The manufacturer fragment/repair/ligation/PCR boundary is supported. The candidate selectively reports parameters and omits such guide details as fragmentation at 32°C for 5 min and post-index-PCR cleanup. At the declared general-assay/delegated scope this is not by itself a missing transformation or a false source gap. It must not be presented as a complete executable manufacturer recipe. This differs from F01 because F01 explicitly purports to encode a decision table that is locally incomplete.

UV-transcriptome comparisons, cross-contamination/efficiency demonstrations, complete image segmentation/statistics, regional epigenome benchmarks and known-dose accuracy are supporting characterization. A general assay extraction need not reproduce every figure, sample count, visual LUT, hypothesis test or cell-signature result. The included characterization stays conditional; omission of the rest is not recorded as a core protocol failure.

limits: No expert or experimental validation is claimed. The preprint reports performance; source fidelity alone does not establish universal biological validity.
This is a purposive audit of a development-exposed case, not a fresh holdout or an estimate of model contamination resistance.
All candidate descriptions were read, but semantic interpretation remains model-authored and can miss errors. No guarantee of zero unsupported claims or missing facts follows.
Natural-language conditions were inspected as qualifications; no exhaustive combinatorial route solver, rendering or executable biochemical compatibility test was performed.
Only text actually represented in the registered packet was used. Missing source images/table rows and unregistered procedures were not recovered from the web.
No exact Module vocabulary, State/Operation count or previous graph decomposition was used as a target.
